name: EI Power Berhad
overview: EI Power Berhad 于2026年5月21日在马来西亚交易所ACE市场上市，首次公开募股发行1.295亿股新股。年内，公司以1720万令吉收购位于Shah Alam的永久业权土地及两层半半独立式工厂，用于扩大营运。财务方面，2025财年营收7739.5万令吉，净利润1934.7万令吉，较2024财年分别增长53.4%和113.6%。
overview_en: EI Power Berhad listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad on 21 May 2026, with an initial public offering of 129.5 million new ordinary shares. During the year, the company acquired a freehold land with a two-and-a-half storey semi-detached factory in Shah Alam for RM17.2 million to expand operations. Financially, FY2025 revenue was RM77.395 million and net profit was RM19.347 million, representing increases of 53.4% and 113.6% respectively over FY2024.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司于2026年5月21日在ACE市场上市，并通过子公司收购物业以扩大营运。
segments.note_en: The company listed on the ACE Market on 21 May 2026 and acquired a property through a subsidiary to expand operations.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 全资子公司EI Power Technologies Sdn. Bhd.以1720万令吉收购位于Shah Alam的永久业权土地（面积1,495.09平方米）及两层半半独立式工厂。
actions.text_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary EI Power Technologies Sdn. Bhd. acquired a freehold land measuring 1,495.09 square metres together with a two-and-a-half storey semi-detached factory in Shah Alam for RM17.2 million.

actions.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING IN CONJUNCTION WITH OUR LISTING ON THE ACE MARKET OF BURSA MALAYSIA SECURITIES BERHAD ("BURSA SECURITIES") COMPRISIN
actions.text: 公司于2026年5月21日在马来西亚交易所ACE市场上市，首次公开募股发行1.295亿股新股。
actions.text_en: The company listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad on 21 May 2026, with an initial public offering of 129.5 million new ordinary shares.
